areas.ag: Rhode Island Dept. of Environmental Management
areas.t: High pressure, continued sun, with SW winds pushing temps well into the 60s for Thursday. Fine particles build late day and into the overnight hours to Moderate. Moderate fine particles early Friday, cleaning out late day with a frontal pass and winds shifting WNW. Highs again in the mid 60s. A touc
